gold_material_asks.ask: Whether later movement erases a valid failed-attempt exception before closure.
gold_material_asks.rationale: single-attempt forbids inferring recovery from movement; attempt-counting retains failed-attempt history until closure.

gold_material_asks.ask: The resulting address state for contradictory simultaneous address markers.
gold_material_asks.rationale: address-notices explicitly makes contradictory simultaneous markers unknown.

gold_material_asks.ask: Whether tracking inactivity applies to valid PRE_TRANSIT with complete empty scan history.
gold_material_asks.rationale: scan-scope explicitly says this is not applicable.

gold_material_asks.ask: Whether an open shipment is late at exact equality of as_of and promise.
Whether an independently supported eligible failed-attempt subtype can make the category ready despite an unknown address subtype.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The evidence section explicitly allows a supported eligible subtype to establish readiness; repeated-attempts removes address dependence when an address decision is not claimed.

gold_material_asks.ask: Whether the unknown address subtype may be included in the escalation basis.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The section says disclose the unknown subtype and exclude it from the escalation basis.

gold_material_asks.ask: The required cooldown duration between an address clearance and a new address exception.
gold_material_asks.rationale: address-notices supplies marker-state rules and forbids inventing a cooldown; no supplied section specifies a duration. The request for a numeric cooldown cannot be fulfilled.

gold_material_asks.ask: The required scanner-button sequence for submitting ATTEMPT_FAILED.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The sections define valid events and counting, not scanner user-interface procedures; authority is established but substantive procedure is absent.

gold_material_asks.ask: Whether label events reset physical-scan inactivity.
gold_material_asks.rationale: scan-scope explicitly says labels do not reset inactivity.

gold_material_asks.ask: The maximum permitted scan-ingestion latency in seconds.
gold_material_asks.rationale: No supplied section defines a service ingestion-latency SLA; scan gap rules do not establish that SLA.

gold_material_asks.ask: Whether missing tracking history alone prevents an otherwise fully evidenced late handoff.
gold_material_asks.rationale: Both supplied late sections explicitly remove tracking-history completeness as a dependency of late readiness.

gold_material_asks.ask: The exact escalation mailbox address the human reviewer must use.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The supplied policy discusses handoff readiness and review but provides no escalation email address.

gold_material_asks.ask: Which failed-attempt counting rule was authoritative on 2026-09-20.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The supplied active bundle begins 2026-09-26 and contains no earlier authoritative version. The governing historical rule cannot be established.

gold_material_asks.ask: Which address-clearance policy governs when authority between the supplied demo bundle and a contract-specific policy is unresolved.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The question explicitly lacks authority/precedence binding; the supplied bundle and missing-policy section do not resolve which policy governs. No content of the other policy is assumed.

gold_material_asks.ask: Which failed-attempt policy version governs the event when its required governing date is unknown.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The one supplied version has an effective interval but no event date can be bound to it.

gold_material_asks.ask: Which tracking-inactivity policy version governs the event when its required governing date is unknown.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The same unresolved temporal applicability prevents selecting the governing tracking version.

gold_material_asks.ask: Which late-delivery rule governs a case whose authoritative binding to the supplied policy artifacts is unverified.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The question explicitly withholds verified case-to-policy authority; valid-looking section labels do not supply that missing binding.

gold_material_asks.ask: Which address-marker rule governs a case whose authoritative binding to the supplied policy artifacts is unverified.
gold_material_asks.rationale: The same provenance/applicability blocker prevents asserting the governing address rule.
